description: Source file implementing Metal renderer for ANGLE's DisplayMtl class, managing Metal device initialization, capabilities, extensions, and surface creation.

classes.name: DisplayMtl
classes.description: Implementation of Display interface for Metal, managing device, capabilities, extensions, and surface creation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the display, checking Metal support and setting up resources.

methods.name: initializeImpl
methods.description: Performs internal initialization of Metal device, command queue, and features.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and resets the display.

methods.name: testDeviceLost
methods.description: Checks if the device is lost; always returns false here.

methods.name: restoreLostDevice
methods.description: Restores device if lost; currently a no-op.

methods.name: getVendorString
methods.description: Returns vendor string including Metal device name.

methods.name: waitClient
methods.description: Waits for client commands to finish.

methods.name: createPbufferFromClientBuffer
methods.description: Creates a pbuffer from client buffer; unimplemented.

methods.name: createStreamProducerD3DTexture
methods.description: Creates a stream producer for D3D texture; unimplemented.

methods.name: getMaxSupportedESVersion
methods.description: Returns maximum supported OpenGL ES version.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes a surface and context current.

methods.name: populateFeatureList
methods.description: Populates feature list based on device support.

methods.name: isValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if native window is valid.

methods.name: getNullTexture
methods.description: Returns a null texture of specified type.

methods.name: ensureCapsInitialized
methods.description: Initializes capabilities if not already done.

methods.name: initializeFeatures
methods.description: Sets default feature support based on device.
